title: Crew Size and the Ridgeline Installation Services Failed-Visit Trip Charge
content:
The crew committed to a Ridgeline Installation Services job grows with the size of the job, and the contract price sets the crew-size share of the failed-visit trip charge.

**Clause.** Crew-size share of the failed-visit trip charge: the contract price billed on the contract is read from its contract billing line; a contract price at or above the large-job floor of 15000.00 takes the large-job multiple of 1.25, a contract price below the small-job ceiling of 3000.00 takes the small-job share of 0.75, and any other contract price takes a crew-size share of 1.

The failed-visit trip charge is multiplied by the crew-size share; neither the share nor any amount formed on the way to the failed-visit trip charge is rounded, the failed-visit trip charge being rounded to the cent only at the end.

| Contract price billed | Crew-size share |
|---|---|
| 15000.00 or more | 1.25 |
| 3000.00 up to, but not including, 15000.00 | 1 |
| below 3000.00 | 0.75 |

## Boundary figures

| Contract price billed | Share |
|---|---|
| 15000.00 | 1.25 |
| 14999.99 | 1 |
| 3000.00 | 1 |
| 2999.99 | 0.75 |

The contract price billed is the price on the contract billing line made at signing; change orders are billed on lines of their own and are not part of it.

**Hypothetical:** a trip charge of 179.00 before the share becomes 223.75 on a contract billed at 21000.00, and 89.00 becomes 66.75 on a contract billed at 1200.00.
